evidence: CHIRON disproved chronological transfer but did not test the legal two-part fixed-corpus regime in which future-informed weights are transmitted and counted.
hypothesis: A compact future-informed but runtime-causal residual model, with every int8 parameter byte explicitly charged, saves at least 2100 net bytes per million on the fixed corpus.
interfaces_exposed: Exact endpoint428 p1 plus completed WRT bytes; transmitted frozen residual parameters; causal runtime state.
kill_condition: Reject paid frozen recurrent residual modeling unchanged if any gate fails; do not sweep model shape, epochs, precision, reset length, optimizer, or quantization.
promotion_condition: Authorize one 10M paid-MDL screen only if exact parent replay passes, gross gain is at least 3000 B/M, projected package-adjusted gain is at least 2100 B/M, and JANUS beats node-bias and circular-shift controls.
retired_neighborhoods: CHIRON chronological residual generalization; page prompts; static residual hashes
title: JANUS paid fixed-population residual MDL oracle
